item.description:
Location: Qatar
Description:

A 2nd Officer position is available on a scientific research vessel operating in Qatar. Applicants must possess at least 5 years of seagoing experience as a deck officer, with specific experience in passage planning, navigation, and safety management. A valid Certificate of Competency as Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch, STCW, ECDIS, GMDSS certificates, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required. The monthly salary ranges from QR 6,000 to QR 7,000, with free work permit, food, accommodation, and transport provided.



Apply to this job
